verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card for AI vendor spend, so agent access to transaction data via API or MCP is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence covers only rewards, perks and card signup. There is no documented API, MCP server, transaction export or coding write-back, and every OpenAPI probe path returned 404. The llms.txt file is a marketing and guides index, not access to expense data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull uncoded transactions via API or MCP, propose categorizations and policy flags, and push clean coding back for review
